en.name: Aaron Yang
en.intro: I'm Aaron, a commerce student at the University of Melbourne. I build systems whose correctness can be measured: an exchange matching engine, end-to-end encrypted file sharing, a finance app that never leaves your computer, and research tools that test their own results.

zh.name: Aaron Yang
zh.intro: 我是 Aaron，在墨尔本大学读商科。我做的系统，对错都能用数字衡量：交易所撮合引擎、端到端加密的文件分享、数据从不离开本机的记账应用，以及会检验自身结果的研究工具。
